origin: Original numerical fixture authored for PixelWall interoperability verification on 2026-09-09. No vendor sample art, profiles, or implementation code included.

oracle.build: Self-built macOS arm64 oracle; executable not redistributed.

method: Create two original black/white layers in the independent linear ICC, save native source, render with Image(sprite.spec):drawSprite, assign that source profile to a new single-cel sprite, call convertColorSpace(sRGB), save expected PNG and JSON. This pins composite-then-convert behavior; it does not claim native default PNG export automatically converts to sRGB.
